Hi Marta — thanks for the heads up.

Quick plan (options you can choose):
1) Manual card update: we can send a secure Hosted Payment Page (HPP) link for a one-time card update that will attempt auth outside the failed flow. This usually avoids the 3DS friction if the issuer accepts it.
2) Invoice reissue: we can void INV-4319 and reissue a corrected invoice (with the updated VAT ID) and send a fresh payment link.
3) Preemptive evidence: if you prefer us to defend a possible dispute, we can assemble a pre-chargeback evidence bundle (contract, signed SOW, delivery logs, IP/call logs). If Stripe still opens a dispute, having the bundle in the first 7 days improves outcome.

We need your go-ahead on which route by EOD tomorrow to keep the dispute window manageable. If you authorize the card update, I will send the HPP and loop in Laura for bookkeeping and evidence gathering.

I'm attaching the current invoice for reference.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes

Camila / team —

Agree with the triage above. Operational notes from Finance:
- If Acme provides a corrected VAT ID we should void and reissue the invoice to ensure correct tax treatment.
- For evidence (if dispute is opened) we need: signed contract, signed SOW, delivery/usage logs for the billing period, invoice PDF, and correspondence authorizing the purchase. Refer to attached checklist.
- Submit the evidence to Stripe ASAP; we should upload within 5 business days.
- If Acme is happy to update the card, ask them to use the HPP. Manual card saves time vs reissue but we must reconcile if the VAT changes after payment.

I can prepare the evidence bundle once Camila confirms which documents we have. Jordan: please confirm whether there are any open technical tickets for the delivery window (we need proof of usage).

Marta —

Thanks, that helps. Two concrete routes below; please reply with which you prefer: 

A) Card update (fastest): I will send a one-time secure payment link. You enter the replacement card; we attempt auth. If auth succeeds we will reconcile VAT after payment and — if needed — issue a corrected credit/invoice.

B) Invoice reissue (clear accounting): Provide the corrected VAT ID and we will void INV-4319 and issue INV-4319-R with the corrected VAT. That will generate a fresh payment link. This is cleaner for your AP team.

If you want us to start evidence collection now, we will compile a preemptive bundle and submit to Stripe while the payment retry is in-flight; Stripe can hold a chargeback if we provide convincing evidence. Please confirm preference and — if B — send the exact VAT ID and billing address.

Secure payment link (example): https://pay.redwood.com/hpp/one-time/abc123 (will send when you confirm card update route)
DocuSign link (for any small amendment to VAT info): https://docusign.com/abc-redwood-vat-amend

Camila
